purpose: Teach: イースト/アーチ/大リーグ/サーモン/マイレージ/聖歌/ダイアナ/カッパ

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、家庭科でイースト菌のパン作ったろ
lines.en: Riku, you made that yeast bread in home ec, didn't you?
lines.style: Casual jab of an opener, half-smirk in the voice. Quick, offhand teen delivery.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、修学旅行でアーチ型の門撮影したろ、桜
lines.en: Well you were the one photographing that arched gate on the school trip, Sakura.
lines.style: Instant comeback energy, mock accusation with a grin. Name tossed at the end like a mic drop.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、大リーグの大谷選手のファンだったな
lines.en: Riku, you were a huge Ohtani fan, right? Big leagues and everything.
lines.style: Knowing, drawn-out delivery, savoring having dirt on him. Slight rise on the accusation.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、給食でサーモンマリネ出てたな、桜
lines.en: And remember when they served that marinated salmon at school lunch, Sakura?
lines.style: Wry, deadpan recall, one eyebrow raised in the voice. Relaxed pace, dry landing on her name.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、お父さんのマイレージで沖縄行ったろ
lines.en: Riku, you went to Okinawa on your dad's air miles, didn't you?
lines.style: Mock-envious accusation, punchy and quick. A jealous little push on Okinawa.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、合唱部で聖歌歌ったろ、桜
lines.en: Yeah, well you sang hymns in choir club, Sakura.
lines.style: Counterattack fired fast, gleeful gotcha tone. Stifled laugh cracking through the last word.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、社会で英王室のダイアナ妃調べてたな
lines.en: Riku, you did your social studies report on Princess Diana and the British royals, huh.
lines.style: Slow, savoring reveal, like laying down a winning card. Flat knowing tone, no question mark.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、林間学校でカッパ伝説の話聞いたろ、桜
lines.en: And you heard that whole kappa legend story at forest camp, didn't you, Sakura.
lines.style: Final jab delivered through a barely-held laugh. Quick, triumphant, trailing into a snicker.
